audit_items.proof_trace: The FlashLoan struct (market.move:39) and ReserveFlashLoan (reserve.move:33) both lack any abilities, enforcing Sui Move's hot-potato pattern: repay_flash_loan verifies exact repayment (line 837). Mathematically, a user who deposits M flash-loaned units as collateral and borrows X against (M+C) must withdraw M to repay; withdrawal safety check then requires C*LTV >= X, but X required (M+C)*LTV >= X — impossible for any M > 0. Flash-loan-inflated collateral cannot be simultaneously recovered and used to underpin unpaid debt, so the borrow capacity check via is_obligation_safe (lines 424-434) is inherently correct even though it evaluates current state.
